Package index

Data Preparation and Representation

Functions for harmonizing expression data and constructing transcriptomic representations

prepare_tumor2line_data()
Prepare query and cell-line transcriptomic data
build_scaled_pca_representation()
Build a cohort-specific scaled-PCA representation
build_reference_pca()
Build a reusable external reference PCA space
project_to_reference_pca()
Project expression profiles into a frozen reference PCA space
apply_lineage_crosswalk()
Apply an explicit source-to-reference lineage crosswalk

Population-Aware Matching

Core cohort-specific and external-reference tumor-to-cell-line matching functions

run_tumor2line()
Run the Tumor2Line workflow
run_tumor2line_with_reference()
Run Tumor2Line matching in a frozen external reference PCA space
run_uot_matching()
Run population-aware unbalanced optimal transport matching
get_top_matches()
Get top-ranked cell lines for each query

New-Query Population Prediction

Functions for adding new query samples to an existing query cohort and rerunning population-aware matching

fit_tumor2line_reference()
Fit a reusable Tumor2Line reference cohort
predict_tumor2line()
Predict candidate cell lines for new query samples using population mode

Evaluation

evaluate_tumor2line()
Evaluate Tumor2Line using known query-cell-line pairs

Visualization

plot_tumor2line_accuracy()
Plot Top1, Top3 and MRR performance
plot_true_pair_ranks()
Plot the distribution of true-pair ranks
plot_top_matches()
Plot top candidate cell lines for one query

S3 Methods

print(<Tumor2LineResult>)
Print a Tumor2Line result
print(<Tumor2LineEvaluation>)
Print a Tumor2Line evaluation
print(<Tumor2LineReference>)
Print a Tumor2Line reference cohort
print(<Tumor2LinePrediction>)
Print a Tumor2Line population-mode prediction
